components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Stock bordered-prominent button filled with the accent; one per screen, usually pinned in the bottom action bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size:17px; font-weight:500; color:#fff; background:#01714C; border:none; border-radius:9999px; padding:14px 24px; width:320px; transition: filter .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); filter:brightness(.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2BC47A; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Stock bordered button, accent-tinted fill and label.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; color:#01714C; background:rgba(1,113,76,.14); border:none; border-radius:9999px; padding:8px 14px; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:rgba(1,113,76,.22); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2BC47A; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Capsule filters in a row placed straight on the worktop; accent fill when selected.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; padding:12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#F7F2E3,#E8F0E0,#F5E6CF); } .ds-chip { font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; white-space:nowrap; padding:8px 14px; border:none; border-radius:9999px; background:#fff; color:#1c1c1e; cursor:pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background:#f2f2f7; } .ds-chip-on, .ds-chip-on:hover { background:#01714C; color:#fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2BC47A; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Stat Fields
components.description: Typed numbers shown large on translucent field tiles, in side-by-side pairs.
components.css: .ds-stats { display:flex; gap:10px; padding:12px; width:340px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#F7F2E3,#E8F0E0,#F5E6CF); } .ds-stat { flex:1; display:block; padding:12px; border-radius:14px; background:rgba(118,118,128,.12); font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-stat span { font-size:12px; color:#6c6c70; } .ds-stat div { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:4px; } .ds-stat input { width:70px; border:none; background:none; font:700 22px Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#1c1c1e; padding:0; } .ds-stat input:focus-visible { outline:none; } .ds-stat:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #01714C; } .ds-stat em { font-style:normal; font-size:15px; color:#6c6c70; }

components.name: Action Tiles
components.description: Accent icon over a short label on a grouped-cell tile; rows sit directly on the worktop.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display:flex; gap:10px; padding:12px; width:340px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#F7F2E3,#E8F0E0,#F5E6CF); } .ds-tile { flex:1; min-height:78px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 4px; border:none; border-radius:16px; background:#fff; color:#01714C; cursor:pointer; transition: transform .12s, background .15s; } .ds-tile span { font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#1c1c1e; } .ds-tile:hover { background:#fbfbfd; } .ds-tile:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2BC47A; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Calorie Ring
components.description: Signature: calories left in the centre of a 12pt accent ring; turns orange when over.
components.html: 760Cal left
components.css: .ds-ring { position:relative; width:116px; height:116px; } .ds-ring div { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-ring b { font-size:22px; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#1c1c1e; } .ds-ring span { font-size:12px; color:#6c6c70; } .ds-ring circle { transition: stroke-dasharray .4s ease-out; }

components.name: Target Bars
components.description: Signature: label and value over a 6pt capsule in the nutrient's colour; figure turns orange past a maximum.
components.html:
Protein112 / 150 g

Carbs180 / 220 g

components.css: .ds-bars { width:300px; display:grid; gap:12px; padding:14px; background:#fff; border-radius:12px; font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-bar p { margin:0 0 5px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:12px; } .ds-bar span { font-weight:500; color:#6c6c70; } .ds-bar b { font-weight:400; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#1c1c1e; } .ds-over b { color:#FF9500; } .ds-bar i { display:block; height:6px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(60,60,67,.12); overflow:hidden; } .ds-bar u { display:block; height:100%; border-radius:9999px; transition: width .4s ease-out; }

components.name: Undo Toast
components.description: Floating material capsule at the top: message plus Undo, gone after five seconds.
components.css: .ds-toast { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:12px 16px 12px 20px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(242,242,247,.8); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); font-family: Roboto, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; color:#1c1c1e; } .ds-toast button { border:none; background:none; font:700 15px Roboto, sans-serif; color:#01714C; cursor:pointer; padding:0; } .ds-toast button:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-toast button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #01714C; outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; }

narrative.overview:
Leanr is the counter you stand at when you order: you read the menu, weigh it against what's left in your day, and pick. The screens have that decisiveness. Bebas Neue headlines read like a menu board, and big Roboto numbers answer the question before any label does. The first thing on each screen is a choice or a number, never decoration.

The counter sits in a warm kitchen, not a gym. Every screen rests on the worktop: a cream-to-wheat gradient with faint timber grain, off-canvas plate rings, paper flecks and a soft accent glow in the top corner. That surface is what makes Leanr feel homely rather than clinical. Controls on top of it are stock iOS, warmed up with Leanr's fonts and accent rather than restyled. Native behaviour, gestures and Dynamic Type stay intact.

Density is moderate: grouped lists, a few signature summaries (the calorie ring, target bars, stat tiles), and one prominent action per screen, pinned above the tab bar.
keyCharacteristics: Menu-board display type over a readable Roboto interface.
A warm, textured worktop under every list, form and sheet.
Numbers as heroes: bold and tabular, with gaps marked plainly (`+`, "partial").
Stock iOS controls tinted with the chosen accent. No custom chrome.
Macro colours that mean the same thing everywhere.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Only the resolved accent carries brand colour in the interface. Never hard-code `.green` or the emerald hex for accent UI; read `AppAccent.resolved(...)` or `.tint`.

rules.name: The Fixed Meaning Rule
rules.body: Macro colours and the over/met signals mean the same thing on every screen and in every widget. Read macro colours through `MacroColours`, never as literal `.blue`, `.orange` or `.red`.

rules.name: The Helper Rule
rules.body: Set type only with `.display(_:)` and `.roboto(_:weight:)`. Never use system fonts or `.custom` directly in the app or its widgets. Big Noodle Titling is local-only and must never be referenced in shipped code.

rules.name: The Steady Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates in place (calories, grams, targets, totals) uses `.monospacedDigit()`, so the figures don't jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Flat Counter Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards, tiles, buttons or sheets. To separate something, change the fill or use material, never add a shadow.

rules.name: The Quiet Texture Rule
rules.body: The worktop's grain, rings and flecks stay at or below 7% ink opacity and never carry information. When the user has Increase Contrast turned on, the texture and accent glow are removed and only the gradient remains.

dos: **Do** wrap every list and form screen in `LeanrList` or `LeanrForm` so it sits on the worktop.
**Do** tint accent UI with `AppAccent.resolved(...)`, and let the Premium lock fall back to Counter Emerald.
**Do** use `.display()` for screen names and `.roboto()` for everything else, including in widgets.
**Do** make the answer the biggest thing on screen: calories left, grams short, a price.
**Do** mark missing data visibly with `+`, "(partial)" or "Not set", never with a zero.
**Do** group a compound visual (ring, bar, summary) into one accessibility element with a spoken label.
donts: **Don't** replace stock iOS controls with custom-drawn buttons, toggles or pickers.
**Don't** add drop shadows or glossy effects; the counter is flat.
**Don't** hard-code `.green` for accent UI. The only fixed green is the "Protein target met" pill.
**Don't** render the worktop texture at more than 7% ink, or keep it when the user has Increase Contrast turned on.
**Don't** use the system font, SF Rounded or Big Noodle Titling anywhere that ships.
